claim.statement: For an original-coordinate carrier M=A0 P with G=M^T M and g=s_min(M), and arbitrary symmetric addition S with K=G^-1/2 M^T S P G^-1/2, s_j((A0+S)P) >= g[1+lambda_j(Sym K)]_+. An arbitrary further symmetric dense tail T of operator norm delta lowers this by at most delta. In particular five carrier modes survive whenever lambda_5(Sym K)>-1 at quantitative margin.
